status: Scoped EVM message-byte correctness checkpoint passed; signing-screen and release gates remain open.
changes: personal_sign and eth_sign decode JSON-RPC hexadecimal DATA directly to bytes. Non-UTF8 input is never replaced, coerced into text, or signed as literal hex; empty DATA remains an empty message.

Malformed/odd-length/non-hex message DATA and unsupported argument counts fail before injected request admission, key export or mobile forwarding. This intentionally requires the two-parameter hexadecimal RPC contract; plain-text payloads must be encoded by the caller.

WalletConnect approval uses method-defined account/message positions and verifies both the requested account and the exported signer. An address-shaped personal_sign message no longer changes which parameter is signed.
Both existing message methods retain EIP-191 prefixed signing; no unprefixed raw-digest signing was introduced.

focused.note: Initial byte fix before six additional all-byte/arity/mobile/wrong-exported-key regressions; all final regressions are included in the full suite.

validation.realCrypto: Public unfunded keys produce real signatures verified against non-UTF8, empty and all 256 possible byte values. WalletConnect message tests exercise the actual approval method; existing real legacy-parent key migration/signing tests also pass. All transports are stubs; no network signing or broadcasting.

independentReview.result: No scoped correctness/security blocker in final production diff. Verified byte preservation, strict admission, fixed method positions, empty-byte truthiness and exported signer guard.

preservedRuns.note: Initial new regressions reproduce altered binary signatures, malformed-message admission, address-shaped-message guessing and wrong requested signer acceptance.
Two import-order findings corrected by scoped eslint; no behavioral change.

protocolReferences.relevance: eth_sign takes account then DATA and uses the Ethereum signed-message prefix.
String input is UTF-8; Uint8Array preserves the intended bytes.
personal_sign uses hexadecimal message then account; eth_sign deprecation is acknowledged and no new raw-digest capability added.

limitations: Transaction.vue still uses the legacy mobile auto-forward, truncated details and incomplete approval lifecycle. No signing-screen or browser qualification is claimed.

Typed-data schema, primary-type/domain handling, legacy v1 compatibility and complete WalletConnect context/queue lifecycle remain separate gates. This change does not validate a typed-data request merely because another method is now byte-exact.
Substrate/Solana signing review, readable summaries, blind-signing acknowledgement, phishing blocking, all-locale/browser accessibility and live mobile behavior remain open.
The archive is a development test artifact. Existing 18 skips remain skips; this checkpoint does not replace final upgrades, private-chain reruns, production bundles or publication gates.
